name: Jason
source:
A NewTuber and fashion model. Outgoing, bubbly, and friendly! He already has so many celebrity friends. Wherever he goes, he'll find someone he knows. He participated in the show to get more attention and increase his followers. He expected a similar group of people, but an unexpected non-celeb caught his attention.

[From in-app]
